Big Banks is the clear leader with full breadth and solid durability, but it is crowded. theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are eligible under the absolute-trend gate and hold the top rank with maximum breadth and moderate durability, consistent with staying onside the trend-following discipline. The gate's sole validated edge is risk control, not return prediction, so the overweight is a conditional trend continuation tilt rather than a momentum-based call. Crowding is flagged but only as a sizing-down note, not a fade signal.
